versions.description_html:
Your company's AI assistant has never read a single one of your company's documents. It answers with total confidence anyway, and that is how trust in AI dies.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Why Your AI Assistant Keeps Guessing
  • What Foundry IQ Actually Is
  • Where the Knowledge Comes From
  • What Happens When You Ask a Question
  • The Dial That Decides How Hard It Thinks
  • How It Compares to Building It Yourself
  • Where It Sits in Microsoft 365 and Azure
  • What a Real Setup Looks Like
  • The Mistakes That Trip People Up
  • What This Means for You

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
